# Orvio 0.50

- Rewind within the programme that is on: on channels with catch-up (⟲), the yellow programme bar now works like a video timeline. On phones, tap or drag it. On TV, hold OK on the playing channel and choose "Rewind this programme", or press ◀ ▶ in full screen; each press moves a minute and it plays once you stop. The far right is live again, and "−7 min · Back to live" (or "Go live" in full screen) takes you straight back.
- Pausing while rewound, or a brief connection hiccup, now continues where you were instead of jumping.
- Phone and tablet in landscape: the top bar and right-hand column no longer slide under the system bars, and channel names in the list have more room.
